items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: we enjoyed the other people working there as well as Bart Howard

ctx.x: He’s telling the truth, but you see at this time a lot of the jazz clubs were drying up, like 52nd Street wasn’t happening anymore, and there weren’t that many clubs. A lot of clubs were closing, and we were thinking what were we going to do next you know. And so when the opportunity came along for us to do this audition, we thought hey that’s great, that’s how we started to getting in to some cabaret, you know what they called cabaret. At that time it was just a joint, it was a saloon you know. But now it’s…
We cleared out our apartment in Hollis, New Jersey, outside of Philadelphia—
